title: Validate unauthenticated public API responses before use
summary: Unauthenticated external API responses are now validated for size, schema, and integrity before being used in tax and financial processing. The hardening covers VIES VAT validation, currency exchange rates, Nemhandel company status, and MTD fraud prevention endpoints.
key_points: Size caps on external responses: 64 KB for VIES and Nemhandel, 10 MB for currency exchange rates, 4 KB for the MTD public IP lookup
VIES responses must echo the requested country code and VAT number, otherwise they are rejected
Nemhandel responses must contain a cvrNummer matching the requested CVR; MTD exits early on non-2xx responses
Every rejection emits telemetry and a Security Audit entry; Nemhandel telemetry no longer logs the request URI or reason phrase
Tests added for size, schema and integrity checks, including CZ, ES and NA VAT test copies
